actual_scope: Source-bound first-range child caller and non-ADD numerical lifetimes; conditional whole-call phase envelope.

stop_rule: One source-bound caller result or precise counterexample; stop research by45minutes and reserve finalquarter for verification/preservation/cleanup. No extra research rounds.

ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; separate math-storage-lifetimes AI specialist. No independent human or formal-kernel review.
